Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Update on Human Rights Commission documenting anti-gay discrimination 2. Interview with Keith O'Connor, Director of Discrimination for the NYC Human Rights Commission COMMERCIAL: "Lust in the Dust" 3. Supreme court refuses to hear Ohio high school guidance counselor's gay discrimination case 4. National Gay Task Force Versus Oklahoma City schools 5. Baltimore city council members vote against gay civil rights (anti-discriminatory) law 6. Carol Bellamy, President of the New York City council, runs for mayor, includes clip of Bellamy at Greater Gotham Business Council COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 7. The Foundation For Traditional Morality blames rise in AIDS to overturned Dallas sodomy law 8. Local Dallas insurance agent misrepresents cancer plan to bar owners, says it includes AIDS, AIDS insurance plans COMMERCIAL: National Fund for Human Dignity with Abigail "Dear Abby" Van Buren 9. Washing D.C. gay activists ask city to help fund AIDS education, counseling, and services 10. Reagan administration lacks AIDS funding support 11. Inter-faith Forum clip on Religion and AIDS COMMERCIAL: Disc-o-rama, NY video and music store 12. Sports 13. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Christopher Collins, Cooperating Attorney with LAMBDA Legal Defense and Education Fund, discusses HTLVIII test 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media reports/current events/culture including Reagan rap and "Pleasure Beach" clip [COMMERCIAL: "Lust in the Dust"] 2. Barbara Esposito and Bruce Hopkins start gay comedy night at Paper Moon, clips and outtakes COMMERCIAL: "Manscape," a gay magazine 3. Interview with psychologist, Dr. Jim Serafini, discusses AIDS and sex fears
